# Metrics

<!-- Generated by scripts/metrics_doc.py from the metric registry: edit those, not this. -->

Every metric an evaluation spec can compute, from teehr-core's metric registry. Name a metric
in an `aggregate` stage by its canonical name or an alias; results always carry the canonical
name (so `kge` gives a `kling_gupta_efficiency` column).

```yaml
aggregate:
  - group_by: [primary_series_key]
    metrics:
      - count
      - kge                                            # an alias
      - {name: hits, threshold: {value: 1000, unit: "[cft_i]/s"}}
      - {name: nse, transform: log}                    # on log values
```

The [spec guide](spec/README.md#metric-options) has every metric option (`transform`, `as`,
thresholds, normalizers, `of` for later stages); the parameters below are the ones particular
metrics take.

In the tables:

- **Unit**: what the result is in. Values are compared in the evaluation unit (`output.unit`,
  default the primary dataset's), so an error such as RMSE is in that unit, and an efficiency
  has none.
- **Merges**: whether the metric can be computed from merged state (running sums kept per
  group and month). Evaluations whose metrics all merge can rerun incrementally, recomputing
  only the months whose data changed, and in shards; one that doesn't merge makes every run
  recompute all pairs at once.
- **Parameters**: **bold** ones are required.

62 metrics; 57 merge.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `threshold` | The event threshold (a value >= it is an event): `{value, unit}`, or `{column: <name>}` for a per-pair threshold | required |
| `normalize_by` | What normalizes the error: `mean_primary`, `range_primary`, `{value, unit}` or `{column: <name>}` | `mean_primary` |
| `side` | Which side the signature describes: `primary` or `secondary` | `primary` |
| `year_start_month` | The month a year starts in (1-12), for annual and timing signatures | 1; 10 (a water year) for timing |
| `missing_day_threshold` | Timing: leave out a year missing more than this share of its days | 0.1 |
| `exceedance` | Flow duration curve slope: the two exceedance probabilities | `[0.33, 0.66]` |
| `log` | Flow duration curve slope: on log values (`true`) or linear | `true` |
| `estimator` | CRPS: `standard` or `fair` (for small ensembles) | `standard` |
| `interval` | The central prediction interval, as two quantile levels | `[0.05, 0.95]` |
| `rank` | Rank histogram: which observation rank among the members to count (0 = below all) | 0 |
| `scale` | MASE: the pair column with each pair's naive scale (`{column: <name>}`, from a `naive_scale` field) | required |
| `sr` | KGE: the weight on the correlation term | 1 |
| `sa` | KGE: the weight on the variability term | 1 |
| `sb` | KGE: the weight on the bias term | 1 |

## Result units

| Unit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `value` | the evaluation unit (a level) |
| `sum` | the evaluation unit (a sum) |
| `difference` | the evaluation unit (a difference) |
| `difference2` | the evaluation unit, squared |
| `invariant` | none (dimensionless) |
| `ratio` | none (a ratio; not with an offset unit such as °C) |
| `time` | a time or duration |

| Metric | Aliases | Definition | Parameters | Unit | Merges |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `count` |  | Number of pairs. |  | `invariant` | yes |

## Error

| Metric | Aliases | Definition | Parameters | Unit | Merges |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `max_value_delta` |  | max(pred) - max(obs). |  | `difference` | yes |
| `mean_absolute_error` | `mae` | mean(\|pred - obs\|). |  | `difference` | yes |
| `mean_error` | `me` | mean(pred - obs). |  | `difference` | yes |
| `mean_square_error` | `mean_squared_error`, `mse` | mean((pred - obs)^2). |  | `difference2` | yes |
| `root_mean_square_error` | `rmse` | Root mean square error: sqrt(mean((pred - obs)^2)). |  | `difference` | yes |

## Relative error and bias

| Metric | Aliases | Definition | Parameters | Unit | Merges |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mean_absolute_percentage_error` | `mape` | Mean absolute percentage error: 100 * mean(\|pred - obs\| / \|obs\|) over pairs with obs != 0; null if there are none. |  | `ratio` | yes |
| `mean_absolute_relative_error` |  | sum(\|pred - obs\|) / sum(obs); null if sum(obs) == 0. |  | `ratio` | yes |
| `mean_absolute_scaled_error` | `mase` | Mean absolute scaled error: mean of \|pred - obs\| / scale, scale being each pair's in-sample naive error (a naive_scale field: its series' mean \|y(t) - y(t - lag)\| over a training period); < 1 beats that naive forecast's typical error. Pairs without a positive scale are left out. | **`scale`** | `invariant` | yes |
| `multiplicative_bias` | `multbias`, `relative_mean`, `relmean` | mean(pred) / mean(obs); null if mean(obs) == 0. |  | `ratio` | yes |
| `normalized_mean_absolute_error` | `nmae` | MAE / normalizer: mean(obs) by default; normalize_by range_primary (max - min), a number (e.g. installed capacity) or a column. Null if the normalizer is 0. | `normalize_by` | `ratio` | yes |
| `normalized_root_mean_square_error` | `nrmse` | RMSE / normalizer (as nmae). | `normalize_by` | `ratio` | yes |
| `relative_bias` | `relbias` | sum(pred - obs) / sum(obs); null if sum(obs) == 0. |  | `ratio` | yes |
| `relative_maximum` | `relative_max` | max(pred) / max(obs); null if max(obs) == 0. |  | `ratio` | yes |
| `relative_median` |  | median(pred) / median(obs); null if median(obs) == 0. Medians come from quantile sketches (within 0.1%), so the metric merges from state. |  | `ratio` | yes |
| `relative_minimum` | `relative_min` | min(pred) / min(obs); null if min(obs) == 0. |  | `ratio` | yes |
| `relative_standard_deviation` | `relative_std`, `relstd`, `variability_ratio`, `vr` | std(pred) / std(obs) (population std); null if obs is constant. |  | `invariant` | yes |
| `symmetric_mean_absolute_percentage_error` | `smape` | Symmetric MAPE: 100 * mean(2\|pred - obs\| / (\|obs\| + \|pred\|)); a pair where both are 0 counts as 0 error. Ranges 0 to 200. |  | `ratio` | yes |

## Efficiency

| Metric | Aliases | Definition | Parameters | Unit | Merges |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kling_gupta_efficiency` | `kge` | Kling-Gupta efficiency (Gupta et al. 2009): 1 - sqrt((r-1)^2 + (alpha-1)^2 + (beta-1)^2), alpha = std(pred)/std(obs), beta = mean(pred)/mean(obs); null if obs or pred is constant or mean(obs) == 0. Weights sr, sa, sb (default 1) multiply the three terms. | `sa`, `sb`, `sr` | `ratio` | yes |
| `kling_gupta_efficiency_mod1` | `kge_2012`, `kge_mod1` | KGE' (Kling et al. 2012): as KGE with alpha replaced by the ratio of coefficients of variation (pred/obs). Weights sr, sa, sb (default 1) multiply the three terms. | `sa`, `sb`, `sr` | `ratio` | yes |
| `kling_gupta_efficiency_mod2` | `kge_2021`, `kge_mod2` | KGE'' (Tang et al. 2021): 1 - sqrt((r-1)^2 + (alpha-1)^2 + beta^2), alpha = std(pred)/std(obs), beta = (mean(pred) - mean(obs)) / std(obs). Weights sr, sa, sb (default 1) multiply the three terms. | `sa`, `sb`, `sr` | `invariant` | yes |
| `nash_sutcliffe_efficiency` | `nse` | Nash-Sutcliffe efficiency: 1 - sum((pred - obs)^2) / sum((obs - mean(obs))^2); null if obs is constant (within rounding). |  | `invariant` | yes |
| `nash_sutcliffe_efficiency_normalized` | `nnse` | Normalized NSE: 1 / (2 - NSE), in (0, 1]; null if obs is constant. |  | `invariant` | yes |

## Correlation

| Metric | Aliases | Definition | Parameters | Unit | Merges |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `coefficient_of_variation_ratio` |  | Ratio of coefficients of variation: (std(pred)/mean(pred)) / (std(obs)/mean(obs)); null if obs is constant or a mean is 0. |  | `ratio` | yes |
| `pearson_correlation` | `pearson_r` | Pearson correlation; null if obs or pred is constant. |  | `invariant` | yes |
| `r_squared` |  | Coefficient of determination as the squared Pearson correlation. |  | `invariant` | yes |
| `root_mean_standard_deviation_ratio` | `rsr` | RMSE-observations standard deviation ratio: RMSE / std(obs); null if obs is constant. |  | `invariant` | yes |
| `spearman_correlation` | `spearman_r` | Spearman rank correlation (ties get average ranks); null if obs or pred is constant. |  | `invariant` | **no** |

## Contingency (events above a threshold)

| Metric | Aliases | Definition | Parameters | Unit | Merges |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `correct_negatives` |  | Pairs where neither is an event. An event is a value >= threshold. | **`threshold`** | `invariant` | yes |
| `critical_success_index` | `csi` | Critical success index (threat score): hits / (hits + misses + false_alarms). An event is a value >= threshold. | **`threshold`** | `invariant` | yes |
| `false_alarm_ratio` | `far` | False alarm ratio: false_alarms / (hits + false_alarms); null without predicted events. An event is a value >= threshold. | **`threshold`** | `invariant` | yes |
| `false_alarms` |  | Pairs where pred is an event and obs isn't. An event is a value >= threshold. | **`threshold`** | `invariant` | yes |
| `frequency_bias_index` | `frequency_bias` | Frequency bias: (hits + false_alarms) / (hits + misses); 1 = as many predicted as observed events. An event is a value >= threshold. | **`threshold`** | `invariant` | yes |
| `hits` |  | Pairs where obs and pred are events. An event is a value >= threshold. | **`threshold`** | `invariant` | yes |
| `misses` |  | Pairs where obs is an event and pred isn't. An event is a value >= threshold. | **`threshold`** | `invariant` | yes |
| `probability_of_detection` | `pod` | Probability of detection: hits / (hits + misses); null without observed events. An event is a value >= threshold. | **`threshold`** | `invariant` | yes |
| `probability_of_false_detection` | `pofd` | Probability of false detection: false_alarms / (false_alarms + correct_negatives). An event is a value >= threshold. | **`threshold`** | `invariant` | yes |
| `proportion_correct` | `accuracy` | Proportion correct (accuracy): (hits + correct_negatives) / count. An event is a value >= threshold. | **`threshold`** | `invariant` | yes |
| `success_ratio` |  | Success ratio: hits / (hits + false_alarms) = 1 - FAR. An event is a value >= threshold. | **`threshold`** | `invariant` | yes |

## Hydrologic signatures

| Metric | Aliases | Definition | Parameters | Unit | Merges |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `average` | `mean_value` | Mean. Of obs or pred (side, default obs); column <name>_<side>. | `side` | `value` | yes |
| `center_of_timing` |  | Center of timing: the flow-weighted mean day of the year (day 1 = the first day of year_start_month, default 10), from daily means, averaged over the years; a year with fewer than 1 - missing_day_threshold (default 0.1) of its days, and days without flow, are left out. Needs the pairs. Of obs or pred (side, default obs); column <name>_<side>. Reads `value_time`. | `missing_day_threshold`, `side`, `year_start_month` | `invariant` | **no** |
| `flow_duration_curve_slope` | `fdc_slope` | Flow duration curve slope: (ln Q(e1) - ln Q(e2)) / (e2 - e1), Q(e) = value exceeded a fraction e of the time, exceedance [e1, e2] default [0.33, 0.66]; null if either value <= 0. With log false, the linear slope (Q(e1) - Q(e2)) / (e2 - e1). Quantiles come from quantile sketches (within 0.1%), so the metric merges from state. Of obs or pred (side, default obs); column <name>_<side>. | `exceedance`, `log`, `side` | `ratio` | yes |
| `max_value_time` |  | Time of the maximum (earliest if repeated). Of obs or pred (side, default obs); column <name>_<side>. Reads `value_time`. | `side` | `time` | yes |
| `maximum` | `max_value` | Maximum. Of obs or pred (side, default obs); column <name>_<side>. | `side` | `value` | yes |
| `minimum` | `min_value` | Minimum. Of obs or pred (side, default obs); column <name>_<side>. | `side` | `value` | yes |
| `standard_deviation_of_timing` |  | Standard deviation of timing: the flow-weighted spread of the days around the center of timing, sqrt(sum q (d - CT)^2 / (sum q (n - 1) / n)) over the n days with flow, per year, averaged over the years (as center_of_timing). Of obs or pred (side, default obs); column <name>_<side>. Reads `value_time`. | `missing_day_threshold`, `side`, `year_start_month` | `invariant` | **no** |
| `sum` | `sum_value` | Sum. Of obs or pred (side, default obs); column <name>_<side>. | `side` | `sum` | yes |
| `variance` |  | Population variance. Of obs or pred (side, default obs); column <name>_<side>. | `side` | `difference2` | yes |

## Timing

| Metric | Aliases | Definition | Parameters | Unit | Merges |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `annual_peak_flow_bias` | `annual_peak_relative_bias` | sum over years of (annual max(pred) - annual max(obs)) / sum of annual max(obs). Years start in year_start_month (default 1, calendar years; 10 for water years). Reads `value_time`. | `year_start_month` | `ratio` | **no** |
| `max_value_time_delta` |  | Seconds from the time of max(obs) to the time of max(pred) (earliest time of each maximum); positive means the predicted peak is later. Reads `value_time`. |  | `time` | yes |

## Probabilistic (ensembles and quantiles)

| Metric | Aliases | Definition | Parameters | Unit | Merges |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ensemble_mean_root_mean_square_error` | `ensemble_mean_rmse` | RMSE of the ensemble mean: sqrt(mean over cases of (mean of members - obs)^2). |  | `difference` | yes |
| `ensemble_spread` |  | Ensemble spread: sqrt(mean over cases of the members' variance), m - 1 denominator; cases with one member are left out. |  | `difference` | yes |
| `interval_coverage` |  | Fraction of cases whose observation falls within the central interval (interval [lo, hi] quantile levels, default [0.05, 0.95]). Reads `quantile`. | `interval` | `invariant` | yes |
| `mean_brier_score` | `brier_score` | Brier score of the event value >= threshold: mean over cases of (p - o)^2, p = fraction of members predicting the event, o = 1 if observed. | **`threshold`** | `invariant` | yes |
| `mean_crps_ensemble` | `crps` | Continuous ranked probability score of ensemble forecasts, averaged over forecast cases: mean\|x - y\| - sum\|x_i - x_j\| / (2 m^2) over a case's m members (estimator: standard, or fair with 2 m (m - 1)). Equals MAE for one member. | `estimator` | `difference` | yes |
| `mean_interval_score` | `winkler_score` | Interval (Winkler) score: width + (2/alpha)(lo - y) if y < lo, + (2/alpha)(y - hi) if y > hi, alpha = 1 - (hi - lo); mean over cases. Reads `quantile`. | `interval` | `difference` | yes |
| `mean_interval_width` | `interval_width` | Mean width of the central interval (hi - lo quantile values). Reads `quantile`. | `interval` | `difference` | yes |
| `mean_pinball_loss` | `pinball_loss` | Mean pinball (quantile) loss over quantile forecasts: q(y - x) if y >= x, else (1 - q)(x - y), q = the pair's quantile level. Reads `quantile`. |  | `difference` | yes |
| `rank_frequency` |  | Share of cases whose observation has rank `rank` among the members (0: below all, m: above all; ties count half, rounded down). One per rank gives the rank histogram. | **`rank`** | `invariant` | yes |
| `rank_histogram_reliability` |  | Reliability index of the rank histogram: sum over ranks of \|frequency - 1 / (m + 1)\| (Delle Monache et al. 2006); 0 is flat. Null when a group's cases have different ensemble sizes. |  | `invariant` | **no** |
| `rank_outlier_fraction` |  | Share of cases whose observation is outside the ensemble's range (rank 0 or m); 2 / (m + 1) for a reliable ensemble. |  | `invariant` | yes |
| `spread_skill_ratio` |  | Spread-skill ratio: sqrt(mean over cases of (m + 1) / m x member variance) / RMSE of the ensemble mean (Fortin et al. 2014); about 1 for a reliable ensemble, below 1 under-dispersed. |  | `invariant` | yes |
